rule.statement: A party claiming prescriptive title to land does not need to strictly comply with Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code if the description of the property in the plaint is sufficient to enable the court to enter a clear and definite judgement, and the description would not impede the execution of the decree.
rule.supporting_quote: Thus, if a party to a case of this nature describes the property in the plaint to a degree or to an extent, that enables the court to enter a clear and a definite judgement and if the description of the property would not impede the execution of the decree, that would be sufficient compliance with Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code
